architecture_override.bootstrap_phase: A bounded reliable ordered FakeTCP setup stream carries real TLS 1.3 / Reality-like admission during the first seconds; production persona remains Firefox-120-like where technically possible.
architecture_override.mode_switch: Authenticated setup switches in-band on the same FakeTCP association to DTLS/datagram mode with no FIN, RST, reconnect or new SYN at the boundary.
architecture_override.hol_rule: Reliable ordered behavior is setup-only. Post-switch payload must retain the mature WBD FakeTCP/DTLS/FEC datagram behavior and must not acquire ordinary kernel-TCP cumulative-stream HOL.
architecture_override.tcp_like_core: The existing FakeTCP/TCP-like recovery core is mature and remains frozen unless a deterministic regression specifically proves it must change.
architecture_override.delivery_rule: Before user delivery, the exact candidate HEAD must pass both hosted Windows-native qualification/build and Linux raw/netns full-stack qualification plus the combined Windows-runtime -> Linux-server gate. Physical Windows Npcap/NIC/NAT/ISP remains final acceptance, not a substitute for automated qualification.
